title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's get Minori's pre-birthday show on the road♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting you guys to celebrate my birthday with a show like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you glad you asked, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, it's not every day that you get to have Miku and the others personally celebrate something for you like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What if this is all a dream?!
Shizuku, pinch my cheek just in case!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you doing to her...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Minori! Girls!
Let's all cheer together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's all give them something to cheer about!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku! Everyone!
That was such a fun show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just the thought of you singing for me fills my heart with so much joy...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
All songs that I really like too.
Your performance was exciting from start to finish...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to replay this show over and over again in my head to make sure I never forget!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're glad you liked it so much♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Especially since we did our best to include as many of your favorite songs, effects and such into today's show, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, that was deliberate?!
You did that just for me?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Impressive.
At this point, it's like a once-in-a-lifetime performance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin, Luka, MEIKO, Len, KAITO...
Thank you all so much for doing this!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
We're happy that we got this opportunity to celebrate your birthday before anyone else.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we are. It's always worth putting on a show for someone we've come to know so well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree♪ It'd be great to do something like this again for Haruka, Shizuku and Airi's birthdays.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? That's a very tempting offer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We hope you get to celebrate and enjoy your birthday tomorrow with all of your friends and family, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too, Miku! Thanks, you guys!
And again, thank you for today's show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is there anything else we need to go over for your birthday stream today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I still don't really think our fans are gonna be interested in my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What if we have zero viewers?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
There's no way that's gonna happen.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She's right, Minori.
Let's just take a deep breath. Here, I'll join you. Relax. Relax...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay... Breathe in... Breathe out... Relax... Relax...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure you'll feel a lot better once your little birthday bonanza starts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Anyway, Shizuku, let's head back to class.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Saki?! Emu?!
What are you two...?! Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Why else but to celebrate your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We had Airi and the others help us get this all set up☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! I had no idea!
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An said she wants to celebrate too, Minori, and sent me a message to read to you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday! I should have time to watch your birthday stream today, so I'll be looking forward to it!>
I can't wait for your birthday stream too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're both gonna watch it?! Thank you so much! Oh, write as many comments as you like too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I will! I'll make sure to tell An that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me next!
I'll read the message Nene sent!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Happy birthday. I know we've both been busy lately, but I hope we get another chance to practice singing again.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here's one from Tsukasa.
<Ah, it's Hanasato's birthday?! Please wish her a happy birthday for me!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki!
Also, you sounded just like Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, before we forget.
We should give you the presents we got you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We went out shopping together and chose whatever made us think, “This is the one!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We chose things that seemed practical, so we hope you get a chance to use them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the presents you said were giving you some trouble? I'm glad you found something nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Shii, what did you get her...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, this is between them, not you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha. It's okay.
I know that's just how Shizuku is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and the others gave me that wonderful show yesterday, and today, all my friends are here to celebrate my birthday with me!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Our fans...
I want them to enjoy this day too.)
